description: The Preferences window webview: it may call our app commands (get_prefs / terminal_presets / set_terminal_pref / loginitem_* / source_use / delivery_* / get_appearance_state / ui_report) and listen for Rust-emitted events (set-appearance / prefs-changed). App-defined commands need no extra ACL; only core + event access is granted, scoped to the `preferences` window (least privilege — it does NOT share `main`'s capability).
